name: London
hook: Old bells, new skyline, a pub for every mood
description: A city that wears its centuries in layers — Big Ben and the Tower of London a short walk from glass towers and a food market that changes with the season, held together by a river you'll cross more times than you plan to.

quickFacts.flightNote: ~7hr direct from the US East Coast
quickFacts.climate: Temperate maritime — mild, often overcast, rain in any season

topExperiences: The Tower of London and the Crown Jewels
A walk across Tower Bridge at golden hour
Borough Market on a Saturday morning
A West End show followed by a proper pub dinner
